verdict.rationale: The pack shows no in-product feature that generates AI insights or suggestions from the user's synced data. The AI support assistant only answers troubleshooting questions from Fivetran documentation. The MCP server lets external agents query connection status, and the 'context layer' feeds the customer's own AI tools; none of these deliver in-product data insights.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
